name: learning-plugins
description: Learning workflow plugins for Oh My Pi and Claude Code, built from one source tree.

plugins.name: md-log
plugins.description: Mirror the session (prompts, prose, quiz and question answers) into a markdown note.

plugins.name: quiz
plugins.description: Graded multiple-choice quiz tool: shuffled options, I don't know, a free-text note, and ✓/✗ feedback with an explanation.

plugins.name: teach
plugins.description: A teaching skill that builds understanding from first principles and checks every step with a quiz, plus a researcher agent that fact-checks on the web.

plugins.name: visual-tools
plugins.description: Mermaid and SVG drawing tools with render-and-look maker agents and the visualize skill.
